mapper.sql: id, email, username, password_hash, full_name, birth_date, plan, saves_count, email_verified_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE username = #{username})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users () VALUES (#{id}, #{email}, #{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{fullName}, #{birthDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{plan}, #{savesCount}, #{emailVerifiedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, full_name = #{fullName}, birth_date = #{birthDate,jdbcType=DATE}, plan = #{plan}, saves_count = #{savesCount}, email_verified_at = #{emailVerifiedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
